assumptions.text: Remote workers waste time catching up on long Slack threads they missed.
remote engineers and product managers on distributed teams have this problem.
This solves it: A browser extension that summarises long Slack threads a remote team member missed, linking each point back to the original message.
These customers can be reached in: Online, English-speaking remote software teams.
The founder can build and test it with: TypeScript, browser extensions, Python; 8 hours a week; 5000 EGP.
Enough of these customers would pay for it.
